summary.en: Syrian forces are reported to be moving troops and advisers toward the Saudi Arabia-Yemen border, while Saudi Arabia is hosting 600 Syrian forces amid fighting with the Houthis. A Syrian sailor was killed while smuggling to the Houthis in Yemen, and a Syrian pharmaceutical tycoon was kidnapped in broad daylight in Aleppo. Israeli violations in southern Syria sparked protests, and anti-Druze hate messages have doubled after elections, spread by pro-government accounts. Syrian forces entered the Roj camp ahead of foreign repatriations, and clashes between two families in Aleppo caused deaths and injuries. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske styrker skal ifølge rapporter flytte tropper og rådgivere mot grensen mellom Saudi-Arabia og Jemen, mens Saudi-Arabia huser 600 syriske styrker midt i kamper med houthiene. En syrisk sjømann ble drept mens han smuglet til houthiene i Jemen, og en syrisk farmasøytisk milliardær ble kidnappet i fullt dagslys i Aleppo. Israelske overtredelser i sørlige Syria utløste protester, og hatmeldinger mot drusere har doblet seg etter valgene, spredt av pro-regjeringskontoer. Syriske styrker gikk inn i Roj-leiren før utenlandske repatrieringer, og sammenstøt mellom to familier i Aleppo førte til dødsfall og skadde. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
